message:
There are some updates to the last handoff (handoffs/handoff-jam-wrapup-2026-11-11.md). The new part:

8. **#506 removed a hidden brake on Citadel's own tests (01:29).** Before it, minion test runs were
   `SCHED_IDLE`, so they yielded to everything. Now they're normal priority, and each
   `--test-concurrency=0` run takes the whole box. At 01:29, #519's and #520's full-suite runs took ~10
   cores together, and load hit ~115. Citadel has no CI, so every change runs the full suite **twice**
   on perigee: the minion's own "Running the full test suite" step, then `land.sh`'s gate run.
   Cara asked "why isn't it running on my CI setup?" In order:
   (a) minions run only the tests their change touches, and leave the full suite to `land.sh`'s single
   gate run (a guidance change);
   (b) give `tools/run-tests.sh` a default concurrency cap (e.g. half of nproc) so one run can't fill
   the box;
   (c) once #510's WSL Linux runner works, give Citadel a CI workflow, and let the land gate accept a
   green CI run for the exact commit, as Peek Auras now does. The ~5 s boot check stays on perigee.
9. **The server stalls for 7–12 s now and then, and it isn't CPU.** At 01:30 the server's cgroup had
   cpu.weight 1000 and cpu.pressure ~0.5%, with no swap, yet `/api/health` took 7.5–11.8 s between
   12 ms answers. The stalls lined up with "restored the Claude session from the database" and
   "cleared 35 MiB of build output on dismissal". Likely synchronous file work on the event loop.
   This belongs with #520 (Slow minute after a restart), but it's lasting well past the first minute.
